answer: Locks are published in summit, expire in nectar, and cedar lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 122 aliases therefore needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 762 identities would post 3753 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
